rows.en:
Let's see?

"Jonan University Mountaineering Club: A Miraculous Return!"

"Of the five members reported lost after going missing in the Yatsugatake mountains, the leader, Tamotsu Nishioka (21), was found and taken to hospital by local volunteer firefighters…"

Hmm… Only one of them survived, huh? A miracle indeed!

What about this story?
Speaking of Yatsugatake, that's where Kazami went to investigate, if I remember right.
No fair, Shiro! Going on a picnic without telling anyone… I want to go too.
Hey! Jiro… Shiro didn't go there to play!
Come to think of it, what did Shiro go there for, anyway?

This is Mr. Nishioka's room.

Only… he keeps saying strange things, about some rocket, or seeing a crayfish monster…

I wonder if the shock of the fall made him hallucinate?

Mm… Anyway, I'll try talking to him.

…!?

Doctor, there's nobody here…?
Heh heh heh… Shiro Kazami, you fell right into our trap! All right, take him to the dungeon!
Sir…
The hateful Shiro Kazami… How shall I dispose of him!?

Terrible news!

That Nishioka fellow has escaped!
What!? Just you wait!

…!?

So it's Destron!
Ah… That's what I saw in the mountains, too!
I knew it! Mr. Nishioka, run, quickly!
Come on, then! You Destron monster!
The traitor Joji Yuki! I, Zariganna, will dispose of you.
So you've come to, Shiro Kazami…
Uuugh… Why are you helping me?
I have a favor to ask…
A favor?
My wife and child are in Tokyo… I want you to warn them.
Warn them? About what?
Destron's Pluton Rocket will be launched today at noon! Its target is Tokyo!

What!?

All right, I'll stop that plan! …So, where is it?
Deep in Sasori Valley…

Deep in Sasori Valley…

All right, first things first… we get out of here!

Right now I have a more important mission…

The traitor Joji Yuki… I'll dispose of you eventually! Gwaaaah…
Wait!
Wait!
Kamen Riders 1, 2 and V3… and Riderman had gathered here, in Sasori Valley.
This is it…?
This is Destron's headquarters?

Yes… There's no mistake.

I've long suspected Destron's headquarters was somewhere around Sasori Valley, and I've been investigating it.
From the looks of it… you'd never think there's a base in a place like this.
That's what makes it suspicious! Destron's headquarters wouldn't be out in the open where it stands out…
All right, let's go…

…!?

Revived monsters…!?
I'd have been happier if they were just stuffed…
But… there are only fifteen minutes left until the Pluton Rocket launches!
Let's go! Yaaah!
Twelve minutes left until the Pluton Rocket launches!
Twelve minutes left until the Pluton Rocket launches!
Damn, nine minutes left!
Damn, nine minutes left!
Yaaah!
Yaaah!

…!?

This passage… no doubt about it! It's the entrance to Destron's headquarters!

…!?

This passage… no doubt about it! It's the entrance to Destron's headquarters!

My loyal members of Destron…

Zero hour approaches, when we fire the Pluton Rocket we developed into Tokyo! At last, our century begins…

It was worth welcoming you to Japan, Great Leader…

My only regret is that the corpses of Shiro Kazami and the other Kamen Riders, and of the traitor Joji Yuki, are not here.

Hahaha… Joji Yuki? His foolishness makes me laugh no end!

He swore loyalty without even knowing he was fated to be used as much as he could be and then eliminated…
Damn it…
Joji Yuki is alive! He never learns… He's right outside that door even now!
What did you say!?
Marshal Armor!
So you've come, Joji Yuki…
Marshal Armor… Don't bother with him! Zero hour is near! Prepare for launch!
Wait, Great Leader! Do you intend to destroy humanity?
What of it? Humanity isn't even worth as much as an insect!
Great Leader… Are you… are you even human!?
Fool! Who said I was human?
Then I… I swore loyalty to a devil!?
Marshal Armor… Six minutes to zero hour! With that, I have nothing more to say…
Prepare for launch!
Wait! Marshal Armor…
You mean to get in my way, Joji Yuki!?
Gwaaaah!

Z… Zariganna! Marshal Armor, your true form… was Zariganna!?

Yaaah!
Three minutes left… No good! We won't make it!
Three minutes left… No good! We won't make it!
Look at that…
That's the launch site!?

Hahaha…

Riders… the rocket's launch button has already been pressed, and the countdown has begun!
What!?
What!?
Thank you for your trouble, hahaha…

Farewell, everyone…

I'm counting on you for the rest! I'll make the Pluton Rocket explode somewhere safe!
Stop, Riderman!
Stop, Riderman!

uncertain: U11941: newspaper headline and article text rendered in quotes inside Tobei's line.
U11941/U11946/U11951/U11954/U11955: 皀岡保 read as 西岡保 "Tamotsu Nishioka" (皀 = 西, cf. 大皀洋 = 大西洋 in B0139).
U11943/U11944: Jiro Sakata and Aki Sakata refer to Shiro Kazami as 志郎さん; "Shiro".
U11947: no closing bracket in the Japanese; sentence ends naturally.
U11948: the speaker who springs the trap is Marshal Armor (the "doctor" in U11946 is likely a Destron agent).
U11958-U11966: speaker "Doctor" is a captive doctor/scientist helping Shiro; not the same as the hospital doctor necessarily.
U11966/U11967/U11971/U11974: さそり谷 romanized "Sasori Valley".
U11974: speaker is V3, but the line reads like a reply to Rider 1/2; kept as written.
U11979: ハクセイ read as 剥製 "stuffed".
U12007-U12008: Marshal Armor is struck mid-line; continuation row narration-kind.
U12012: Zariganna (Marshal Armor's true form) shows them the launch site.

new_names.why: speaker_jp 皀岡保 with speaker_en null; glyph 皀 = 西
